description:
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
- How can we assume that Daniel 7:10 is the incident of 1844. Please explain with regard to the ancient of days did sit. Who is the Judge? God or Christ? Who is the Judge in this particular judgment?
- Is is true that earth will be the new headquarters of the universe? In Revelation 21:22 since the Lord God almighty and the Lamb will be in the new Jerusalem, which will come down to earth. What will happen to the present heaven where God, Jesus and His angels live?
- Do you have a PDF of the literary structure of Revelation 12-22? Is this available?

I'd Like To Know is a weekly live SUMTV.org program - Every Tuesday at 4:30pm Pacific Time. 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
